description:
In `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/`: `new_unchecked` in `field.rs` is identical to `new`, so the `_unchecked` name promises a skipped validation that does not exist; `BarrettReducerWide::new` in `barrett.rs` accepts $m \le 64(N-1)$, where `field_mask` underflows; `NAME` and the `MODULUS_HIGH_BIT_*` constants in `wide_config.rs` have no consumer.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `new_unchecked` skips a validation that `new` performs and documents its precondition per `@/inv/caller-trusted-fast-paths`, or it is removed.
- [hard] REQ-02: `BarrettReducerWide::new` rejects every degree it cannot reduce, covered by a boundary test.
- [hard] REQ-03: Constants without a consumer are removed.
title: GF(2^m) constructors and constants without effect
